description: This file defines plan metadata, period metadata, and functions to retrieve and manage subscription plans within the Notesnook project. It includes constants for plan details, functions to fetch plans from a database, and a hook to use plans with loading states.

methods.name: getPlans
methods.description: Fetches subscription plans available to the current user, sorted by plan level.

methods.name: getAllPlans
methods.description: Fetches all available subscription plans, including those without trials, and combines them uniquely.

methods.name: usePlans
methods.description: React hook to load plans with optional loading of all plans, providing loading state and plan data.
